settings.title: CodeScout
apiKey.description: API key for the selected provider. Keep it private; it is stored as a secret.
model.description: Model name understood by the selected provider.
baseUrl.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible base URL. Set this for Ollama, LM Studio, or a proxy.
maxFiles.description: File limit per full audit. Anything that does not fit is reported as a separate Output line.
docLinks.description: Project documentation links. A full audit fetches their texts (limits come from docMaxLinks and docMaxKb, 5s timeout, cache .codescout/docs-cache.json for 24h) and adds a 'Project documentation' section to the prompt.
docMaxKb.description: Maximum size of one documentation file injected into the prompt (KB). Larger docs are truncated to the limit (the head is kept).
docMaxLinks.description: Maximum number of documentation links fetched per full audit.
maxLines.description: Maximum lines per file in an audit. 0 = no limit: files longer than 800 lines are chunked with a 50-line overlap, findings are deduplicated. N > 0 = files longer than N are skipped (for weak models).
auditScope.description: Full-audit scope: comma-separated glob patterns (e.g. src/**, extension/src/**). Empty = all files. The right-click context review ignores it.
auditPasses.description: How many review passes to run per file in a full audit (1-3). From the 2nd pass the prompt includes previous findings with an instruction to look for missed ones; findings from all passes are merged with dedupe.
rateLimitPauses.description: How many times to pause and retry a file on 429/network errors (ladder 120s→300s→600s). 0 = old behavior (skip after one quick retry).
fileCooldown.description: Pause between files during scans even when nothing failed (seconds, 0-30). 0 = no cooldown — right for local models like Ollama. Default 5s, 10s for multi-pass audits.
autoResume.description: Autonomous mode (auto-catch-up): on rate-limit/network issues the audit resumes itself from the checkpoint with a 30s→60s→2min→5min backoff. A user stop kills both the request and the auto mode. There is no auto-start when VS Code launches.
autoResumeMaxAttempts.description: Maximum auto-catch-ups per audit run. 0 = unlimited (needed for big multi-pass projects).
autoResumeMaxMinutes.description: Maximum number of minutes during which auto-catch-up is allowed. 0 = unlimited.
language.description: Language of the extension UI and model reports (RU/EN). Also switchable via the globe button in the panel.
showAuditBanner.description: Show the full-audit welcome banner on window start.
uiTheme.description: CodeScout panel theme. auto — VS Code colors; dark/light — fixed palette; custom — own palette (codescout.customColors).
customColors.description: JSON palette for uiTheme=custom: {"bg","card","fg","desc","border","accent","inputBg","inputFg"} — #hex values. Broken colors fall back to the token default.
accentColor.description: Accent color (--cs-accent). auto — VS Code button/link.
showConfidence.description: Show the model confidence percentage on findings.
findingsSort.description: Order of findings and sections in the report.
reportTheme.description: Theme of the exported HTML report (also applied to the preview).
